content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Status: deviation** (INSURANCE, § 14.1)

- **What exists:** M&I must maintain CGL with $2,000,000 primary limits, fidelity at $10,000,000, workers' compensation with $500,000 employer's liability, and all-risk property cover, plus Certificates of Insurance on Customer's request (p0217). Those elements meet or exceed the preferred position.
- **What fails:** No professional liability (E&O) and no cyber/privacy liability coverage, even though M&I processes our customer data as a data-processing/hosting vendor. Fidelity insurance addresses employee dishonesty only and does not substitute for either. This falls short of the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) on a material term.
- **Redline (validated):** Two new items after p0216 — item 5 adding E&O at $2,000,000 and item 6 adding cyber/privacy liability at $5,000,000 — with the fallback limits flagged in the comment as an acceptable landing zone.
